summary: The exact candidate is valid test-only hardening that guards the already-correct opt-in Mooncake transfer-batch default. It changes no runtime code and does not verify or fully resolve the original GLM-5.2-FP8 multi-node Mooncake/DeepEP timeout.

tests.what_was_measured: Exact candidate regression and existing Mooncake batching mechanics: 6 tests passed and 3 subtests passed.

tests.command: /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-f1ac32f87fe1/venv/bin/python -m pytest -q test/registered/unit/disaggregation/test_mooncake_transfer_batching.py -k 'slices_index_arrays or legacy_single_batch or stops_after_first_failed or device_page_indices or custom_mem_pool'
tests.what_was_measured: Independent selection of ordered slicing, short-transfer boundary, failure stopping, device-index, and custom-pool behavior: 5 tests and 3 subtests passed.
Adversarial environment isolation: the regression reads the supported effective override and fails with 1024 != 0; normal clean-environment execution passes.

gpu_execution.evidence: No GPU execution was relevant to the candidate's CPU-only configuration regression. Import inspection found one AMD Instinct MI350X gfx950, not the required H100 multi-node topology.

remaining_counterexamples: The original GLM-5.2-FP8 deployment was not reproduced before or after the candidate.
The reported 2-node prefill and 4-node/32-rank H100 decode topology with Mooncake/RDMA, DSA, HiCache, HiSparse, and DeepEP remains untested.
The source follow-up's DeepEP-enabled freeze is not exercised or fixed by a Mooncake default-value regression.
Cross-model and cross-KV-layout safety and efficacy of any nonzero batch size remain undemonstrated.
The new test assumes a clean SGLANG_MOONCAKE_MAX_TRANSFER_BATCH_INDICES environment and fails under a deliberate supported override.
remaining_limitations: Only one AMD Instinct MI350X gfx950 GPU is available; no NVIDIA H100 is present.
GLM-5.2-FP8 weights and the required multi-node Mooncake/RDMA deployment are unavailable.
No native rebuild was needed because the candidate has no native or runtime source changes.
